definitions.explanation: a time of year when business or activity is at its highest level

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{繁忙期|はんぼうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}めない→休める：02437_yasumeru⟧。
examples.english: I can't take time off during the busy season.

examples.japanese: {繁忙期|はんぼうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Prices go up during peak season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}{年始|ねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物流|ぶつりゅう}→物流：05137_butsuryuu⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繁忙期|はんぼうき}だ。
examples.english: The year-end and New Year period is the busy season for the logistics industry.

notes:
{繁忙期|はんぼうき} refers to a time of year when business or activity is at its highest level. It is a standard business and travel term.

FORMS:
⟦{繁忙|はんぼう}→繁忙：22531_hanbou⟧ (busy, hectic) + {期|き} (period).

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{閑散期|かんさんき}→閑散期：08367_kansanki⟧ (slow season, off-peak period).
- ハイシーズン: high season (loanword, mainly for tourism)
- ⟦ピーク→ピーク：11174_piiku⟧: peak (general loanword)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {繁忙期|はんぼうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the busy season
- {繁忙期|はんぼうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to face the busy season
- {繁忙期|はんぼうき}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: peak-season pricing

INDUSTRY EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧{商戦|しょうせん} (year-end sales), ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧, ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧
- ⟦{引越|ひっこ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧: 3⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧～4⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧ (moving season in Japan)
